title: Traffic cutover checklist and postflight preflight for feature experiments
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Why: As we run more multi-arm A/B tests and progressively roll out model or routing changes, on-call and cross-functional teams need a single, actionable traffic-cutover checklist plus a short postflight preflight that reduces operator friction and speeds rollback when thresholds are breached. This ticket builds a canonical checklist, notification protocol, and a postflight artifact template so teams can run safe cutovers and produce consistent postmortems.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical traffic-cutover checklist published in Confluence with clear owner for each line item
Postflight preflight template saved under /ops/experiments with a populated example for the upcoming reroute experiment
Alerting hooks and dashboard links included so on-call can validate signals within 3 minutes of cutover
Two run-throughs completed with Product / Eng / SRE and annotated action items resolved
Rollback criteria documented and automated where possible (feature flags, routing rules)
milestones: Draft checklist and escalation ladder (owner: Liam Chen) - 2026-01-26
Integrate dashboard links and alert URIs (owner: Observability) - 2026-02-10

metrics: Primary signal: request success rate delta (5m rolling) - threshold: >0.5% drop triggers investigation
Secondary signal: P95 latency change - threshold: +100ms above baseline
Model quality regression metric: coherence-drop rate on eval set - threshold: 2%
Customer-facing error rate: >0.2% increase triggers automatic rollback
False-positive guard: require 3 consecutive evaluation windows before auto-rollback unless customer-impacting
rollout_steps: 1) Preflight: run quick synthetic smoke + runbook signoff by SRE and PM
2) Start canary: route 0.5% traffic, monitor for 15 minutes
3) Expand: 5% traffic with metric checks at 5/15/30 minutes
4) Gradual ramp: double traffic every 30 minutes until target, with manual gate at 25%
5) Full cutover: switch routing mapping and annotate in experiment dashboard
6) Postflight: run the preflight checklist in reverse (data collection sanity checks, log retention, tracing bubbles)
preflight_checks: Team readiness: on-call and PM assigned and reachable
Feature toggles: safe kill-switch validated and exercised in staging
Dashboards: links to per-route latency, success rate, error buckets, and model quality eval
Automation: rollback playbook (scripted flag flips / routing change) tested in canary env
Data access: required logs and traces available to SRE and PM for 30 days
Legal/Compliance: confirmed no PII leak in synthetic tests
escalation_ladder: Triage (0-10m): on-call + PM review alerts and determine severity
Action (10-25m): if severity high, execute immediate rollback procedure and communicate to stakeholders
Incident (25m-2h): SRE lead opens incident bridge, execs notified if customer-impacting
Postmortem (72h): owner documents findings in template and assigns follow-ups
